name: Feature request

title: "feat: "
labels:
  - enhancement
assignees: []
---

## Problem

Describe the user problem or diagnostic limitation and who encounters it.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior. Example evidence codes, report fields, commands,
or provider capabilities are helpful.

## Alternatives

Describe current workarounds or alternative designs.

## Compatibility, disclosure, and authority

Call out schema changes, new evidence disclosure, provider trust, generated
authority, remediation behavior, or migration concerns.

## Additional context

Add links, evaluation cases, or relevant prior art. Do not attach private logs
or credentials.
